metadata.description: SpecStory's agent skills: turn your AI coding sessions into durable, installable expertise.

plugins.name: specstory
plugins.description: Auto-save every AI coding session as git-friendly markdown in .specstory/history — lifecycle hooks run `specstory sync` after each turn. No prerequisites: if the specstory binary is missing, the plugin walks you through installing it (or run /specstory:setup).

plugins.name: lore
plugins.description: Mine your SpecStory coding histories into a persistent corpus and forge your repeated workflows into installable agent skills.
